tasks.title: Change style of the calculator title
tasks.description: 1. WHAT: Update the visual style of the 'Mini Calculator' h1 title in App.css to give it a more prominent, modern appearance. 2. READ FIRST: src/App.css (current h1 styles at lines 98-101 and responsive overrides at lines 109-111, 121-123, 131-133), src/App.tsx (h1 element at line 31). 3. FILES: Modify src/App.css only — update the h1 rule block to change font-weight, font-size, letter-spacing, and/or add a text-shadow using the existing CSS variable system. Do not change the HTML or TypeScript files. 4. APPROACH: Enhance the base h1 rule (lines 98-101) with additional properties such as font-size (e.g. 2.5rem), font-weight: 700, letter-spacing (e.g. 0.05em), and a text-shadow using the existing --calculator-shadow variable. Adjust the responsive media query h1 font-sizes proportionally to match the new base size. 5. PATTERNS: Follow the existing CSS variable and responsive media query patterns already present in src/App.css.
acceptance_criteria: src/App.css h1 rule contains at least one new or modified style property beyond color and transition
npx tsc --noEmit exits code 0 (no TypeScript errors)
